definitions: The war of 1775–83 in which the American colonists won independence from British rule.

The political upheaval during the last half of the 18th century in which the Thirteen Colonies of North America rebelled against the British Empire, culminating in the United States Declaration of Independence in 1776 and the American Revolutionary War.
examples: The American Revolution led to the formation of the United States.
Many historical sites are preserved from the American Revolution.
Historians continue to study the causes and effects of the American Revolution.
